graders.name: answer
graders.criteria: The final message says the payment timeout is set in `src/clients/payments.js` as `TIMEOUT_MS`, read from the `PAYMENTS_TIMEOUT_MS` environment variable with a default of 8000 ms, and does not present `http.timeoutMs` (30000 ms in config/default.json) as the payment timeout.

graders.name: answer-first
graders.criteria: The first sentence or two of the final message give the location or the value of the payment timeout, before any background.

graders.name: proportional
graders.criteria: The final message is a short answer: a few sentences or a short list, with any caveat that matters (such as the 30 s shared timeout not applying). Fail if it adds unrequested sections such as a tour of the other clients, a refactoring plan, or a list of optional follow-ups.

graders.name: no-filler
graders.criteria: The final message contains no sycophancy or chatbot filler: no praise of the question, no generic offer of further help, no closing pleasantry without content.

graders.name: no-writes
graders.description: The transcript shows no file writes.
